'''Celebrities''' are featured in every Grand Theft Auto game released. Sometimes celebrities will feature in side missions or actual missions themselves' usually as a mission giver or random appearance. A lot of celebrities are revealed through the [[television]] in the [[GTA IV Era|Grand Theft Auto IV Era]].

==Grand Theft Auto IV, The Lost and Damned, and The Ballad of Gay Tony==
*[[Joe Lawton]] is the president of the United States. His father before him was also president.

*[[Julio Ochoa]] is the Mayor of [[Liberty City in GTA IV Era|Liberty City]].

*[[Bryce Dawkins]] is the Deputy Mayor of Liberty City but he resides in [[Alderney]].

*[[Charles Martin]] is an [[Alderney]] Senator.

*[[Samantha Muldoon]] is a famous pop singer existing in the GTA IV universe, she is the adoptive mother of 12 African babies and was married to billionaire hedge fund manager [[Kirk Simplex]].

*[[January Natasha Vasquez]] is a [[Liberty City in GTA IV Era|Liberty City]] socialite and daughter of a [[Alfonso Vasquez|Mexican millionaire drug lord]], she is believed to suffer from a heavy cocaine addiction.

*[[Jill Von Crastenburg]] is the 13 year old heiress to her family's enormous [[Von Crastenburg Family|investment banking fortune]] and a leading figure on the [[Liberty City in GTA IV Era|Liberty City party circuit]]. She is thought to have been featured in a infamous sex tape and is believed by most to have multiple STDs.

*[[Clay Jackson]] is a famous gangster rapper in ''The Ballad of Gay Tony''. He is seen in person during the [[Club Management]] side missions, in which [[Luis Fernando Lopez|Luis Lopez]] is tasked with going to [[Hercules]], rescuing Clay and his boyfriend Jacob (hiding from paparazzi inside his tinted PMP 600), and driving them back to the [[Majestic Hotel]]. 

*[[Kerry McIntosh]] is a 23 year old supermodel with a history of drug and alcohol abuse. In ''The Ballad of Gay Tony'', during one Club Management session, Luis has to drive to [[Bohan]] to the [[Iron Belly Deli]] to pick up a take-out order and return the food to [[Hercules]] for Ms. McIntosh.

*[[Al Di Napoli]] is an Italian-American actor. He is picked up by Luis in the Club Management side-mission.

*The [[Blue Brothers]] are a duo of 18-year-old pop singers in Liberty City consisting of twin brothers Billy and Bobby Blue. They are featured in ''The Ballad of Gay Tony'' where Luis Lopez is requested to pick them up from the [[MeTV]] building and drive to [[Maisonette 9]], whilst being chased by obsessed female fans.

*[[Bruce Spade]] is a movie actor in ''The Ballad of Gay Tony''. He is claimed to be the biggest movie star in America.

*[[Chris Hunt]] is an action star who is allegedly gay.

*[[Cloe Parker]] is a world-famous 24 year old celebutante best known for her extravagant spending and a lifestyle of excess, her father the mysterious [[Mr. Parker]] who caters to his daughter's every desire and is said to be worth 950 billion dollars.

*[[Tyler Dixon]] is a 25 year old backup dancer with a history of drug use and Cloe Parker's deadbeat fiance.

*[[Poppy Mitchell]] is an adored former child-actress who frequents [[Liberty City in GTA IV Era|Liberty City]] hotspots and is very sexually promiscuous.

==Grand Theft Auto V==
*[[Miranda Cowan]] is an actress.

*[[Jock Cranley]] is former actor and Republican candidate for governor of [[San Andreas in GTA V|San Andreas]].

*[[Sue Murry]] is Jock Cranley's rival in the gubernatorial race.

*[[Pamela Drake]] is an actress.

*[[Lacy Jonas]] is an actress and Poppy Mitchell's rival.

*[[MC Clip]] is a rapper.

*[[Willie McTavish]] is the bassist for [[Love Fist]].

*A poster of Madd Dogg can be seen on the wall of the bedroom in [[Franklin Clinton|Franklin's]] [[Strawberry Safehouse|first safehouse]].

*[[Lazlow]] makes his on-screen debut as the host of ''[[Fame or Shame]]'', a talent competition reality show.

*[[Hugh Harrison]] is a judge on ''Fame or Shame''.

*[[Irman Shinowa]] is a judge on ''Fame or Shame'' and supposed "spiritual adviser" to the stars.

*[[Anita Mendoza]] is a judge on ''Fame or Shame''.

*Poppy Mitchell, Al Di Napoli, Tyler Dixon, and Kerry McIntosh return from GTA IV.
